unresolved.detail: The data sheet states no function for DA2/DA3 (pins 25-26, 29-30) and DB2/DB3 (pins 43-44, 47-48) with their port in C-PHY mode. They are bonded only with their port's DPHY choice, so in C-PHY mode they are unmodeled (UNMODELED_PIN if connected); 'leave pins open if unused' still applies.

The CSI-2 absolute maximum min(VTERM + 0.1 V, 1.36 V) is resolved per component from the declared supply on VTERM's net. ERC evaluates it only for CSI-2 pins on nets with a declared supply (signal nets carry no voltage); if such a pin's VTERM net has no declared supply, ERC reports VOLTAGE_LIMIT_UNRESOLVED and applies only the 1.36 V cap. No operating pin-voltage range is given.
CopperScript has no trio signal-group kind, so the C-PHY trios (DD0A-DD0C, DD1A-DD1C, DE0A-DE0C, DE1A-DE1C) are modeled as individual pads; ERC does not report a partially connected trio.

Orderable side-wettable T4877Y+11 uses outline 21-100045 / land pattern 90-100016, which were not obtainable. The KiCad footprint follows 21-0144 (tags T4877+3/+3C); its 5.1 x 5.1 mm EP is not verified for T4877+11 or T4877Y+11. Lead lands, EP size, paste apertures and side-wettable flank lands remain unverified.
MAX96792A data sheet Rev 2 (4/26) exists but was not obtainable. Pinout, names and limits here come from Rev 1 (1/24) and must be re-checked against Rev 2.
Source hash is of a third-party mirror copy; the analog.com file was not retrieved.
EP must reach the ground plane through an array of vias; via count/pattern is not specified in the data sheet.
VDD and VDDIO operating ranges are two discrete bands each; the part models only the outer envelope, so ERC does not reject voltages inside the gaps.
